mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_ai_model_price ORDER BY provider_code, model_name
SELECT * FROM biz_ai_model_price WHERE provider_code = #{providerCode} AND model_name = #{modelName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_ai_model_price (provider_code, model_name, display_name, input_price_per_1k, output_price_per_1k, price_status, price_note, update_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{providerCode}, #{modelName}, #{displayName}, #{inputPricePerThousand}, #{outputPricePerThousand}, #{priceStatus}, #{priceNote}, #{updateBy}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE input_price_per_1k = VALUES(input_price_per_1k), output_price_per_1k = VALUES(output_price_per_1k), price_status = VALUES(price_status), price_note = VALUES(price_note), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(AVG(result_row.prompt_tokens)) AS avgPromptTokens, ROUND(AVG(result_row.completion_tokens)) AS avgCompletionTokens, COUNT(*) AS sampleCount FROM biz_practical_ai_result result_row INNER JOIN biz_practical_ai_job job ON job.job_id = result_row.job_id WHERE job.provider_code = #{providerCode} AND job.model_name = #{modelName} AND result_row.prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND result_row.completion_tokens IS NOT NULL
